findings.title: Redact credentials across truncation and JSON decoding boundaries
findings.details: Raw bytes are tail-trimmed before known credential redaction, so a credential crossing the cutoff is partially retained without matching the complete credential. Inspect output is also redacted before JSON decoding; quote/backslash escapes can prevent matching a complete known credential that is subsequently restored and written inside State.Error or health Output.

independentCounterexamples.result: 27 credential bytes retained with no redaction marker

independentCounterexamples.case: Fictional API_TOKEN containing a quote is JSON-escaped in inspect Error
independentCounterexamples.result: Entire known credential survives into the saved report State.Error

findings.suggestion: Match credentials with sufficient truncation overlap and prevent partial boundary exposure; redact decoded selected inspect strings before serialization. Use a single bounded replacement pass rather than repeatedly processing inserted markers.

findings.title: Terminate the diagnostic process group when cancellation follows leader exit
findings.details: The finally block skips killpg when timeout has not elapsed and the group leader already exited. A descendant that retains the pipe remains alive if selector processing is interrupted.
findings.independentCounterexample: A short local parent forked a pipe-holding child and exited. KeyboardInterrupt during selector wait preserved the interruption but left the child sleeping; the independent probe explicitly killed its own process group afterward.
findings.suggestion: On exceptional/cancelled capture, terminate the process group even if its leader has already exited; preserve the primary exception and close the pipe in a nested finally.

controls: Ordinary diagnostic timeout with exited leader and pipe-holding descendant killed the group in approximately 0.151 seconds.
Startup KeyboardInterrupt still invokes Compose down; cleanup failure preserves the original cancellation.
Source inspection shows successful telemetry assertions, startup/cleanup deadlines and success report remain unchanged.
Diagnostic commands request logs and State only; selected State/Health keys omit Config/Env. The redaction boundary findings are separate from command selection.
